svg.title: Where the web fallback helps and where it hurts. When the menu has nothing, the graph searches the web. For general knowledge, like what Super Tuscan means, the web knows the answer. For facts only this restaurant has, like which of your wines suits the Signature Steak or who the head chef is, the web answers a different question: a general steak and wine guide, or what a head chef does. A sturdier graph would first decide whether the question is about this restaurant.
